libraries.name: Apache ECharts
libraries.limitations: Analytical charts; local series only, text-safe tooltips, accessible tabular equivalent. Adapter covers solid bar/pie/scatter states and disables line emphasis; other series require explicit state review.

libraries.name: React Flow
libraries.limitations: Editable nodes/edges; React required. Preserve base CSS and provide keyboard actions.

libraries.name: vis-timeline
libraries.limitations: Use standalone import, local items and explicit time zone/date semantics. No HTML from imports.

libraries.name: Frappe Gantt
libraries.limitations: Task schedules only; dates do not establish resource-feasible optimization. Copy distributed CSS because its export map omits a CSS subpath. No destroy API: retain one mounted instance per document; do not recreate on view changes.

libraries.name: Tabulator
libraries.limitations: Local data only. Disable remote loading; use plaintext formatters for imported strings.

libraries.name: Motion
libraries.limitations: Nonessential animation honors reduced motion; never drive simulation calculations by animation frames.

libraries.name: Mantine
libraries.limitations: React controls; import core styles then local overrides; system fonts only. Supplemental react-remove-scroll-bar notice required.

libraries.name: reveal.js
libraries.limitations: Local interactive slides; no remote embeds. Resize charts after slide changes and preserve input keyboard interaction. Import reveal.js/reveal.css; disable automatic scroll activation in the embedded responsive recipe.

libraries.name: Mermaid
libraries.limitations: Strict security, local authored diagrams, no external icons/images or clickable URLs; KaTeX override required.

libraries.name: Papa Parse
libraries.limitations: Local CSV text/files; no download URLs. Schema/number/range checks remain application responsibilities.

libraries.name: Arquero
libraries.limitations: Local tabular transformations; fixed authored expressions, never compile imported expressions.

libraries.name: jStat
libraries.limitations: Deterministic statistical functions; justify assumptions/tolerances. Use a separate approved RNG for simulations.

libraries.name: seedrandom

files: seedrandom.js (opening MIT notice; supplemental file bundled)

libraries.limitations: Local generator instances only; no global Math.random replacement. Not a security random source.

libraries.name: Leaflet
libraries.limitations: Local GeoJSON and locally bundled geographic assets only; no remote tiles, geocoding or location permission. Retain data attribution and keyboard/table alternatives. Independently reviewed state-level market screen; approval does not cover remote map services or arbitrary geographic models.

libraries.name: DuckDB-Wasm

files: Supplemental upstream LICENSE at package gitHead a20b8290e79e37a7b914e62621aa412d69ba95fc

libraries.limitations: Candidate: isolated browser probe passed; full application review pending. Single-thread EH worker and local WASM assets for Pages without isolation headers. Disable extension auto-install/autoload and external access; lock configuration. Bounded local queries with cancellation/recovery. Supplemental package license required.

libraries.name: HiGHS
libraries.limitations: Candidate: isolated browser probe passed; full application review pending. Local WASM in a dedicated worker, bounded solve time, explicit integrality and feasibility tolerances. Terminate/recreate worker for cancellation. A feasible incumbent is not proof of optimality.

libraries.name: Remotion browser video
libraries.limitations: Candidate: isolated silent MP4 export/playback passed with optional audio encoders excluded by explicit Vite aliases; full application review remains unresolved. Controlled silent templates, WebCodecs capability checks and forced muted rendering. Audio export is unsupported; this configuration does not resolve audio-codec source obligations for other configurations. Remotion license eligibility must be established. User-approved video-only exception: render-event telemetry sends IP, origin, render type/status to Remotion, never video content. Disclose before rendering; no analytics elsewhere.
